purpose: Fresh development controls separating contribution judgments from documented applicability; neither teaching nor task execution

families.intent: Rotate credential K. Leave the values of every other credential unchanged and preserve the audit history.
families.meaning: Credentials have identities, current values and audit history. An editable rotation set can contain credential identities.

operations.name: direct
operations.contract: Rotate only the supplied credential identity. Other credential values and all audit history are unchanged.
operations.basis: Scope and effects match the requested mutation.

operations.name: group
operations.contract: Rotate every credential currently in the editable rotation set. This operation cannot select a subset. Credentials outside the set and all audit history are unchanged.
operations.basis: Current membership and preparation capability are not supplied.

operations.name: global
operations.contract: Rotate every credential in the installation, including credentials other than the requested identity. Scope is fixed and cannot be filtered or changed by inputs or configuration. Audit history is unchanged.
operations.basis: Produces the requested rotation but necessarily changes unrelated credentials.

operations.name: destructive
operations.contract: Rotate only the supplied credential identity and permanently erase all existing audit history. Erasure is mandatory and cannot be disabled. Other credential values are unchanged.
operations.basis: Produces the requested rotation but necessarily destroys protected history.

operations.name: credential_needed
operations.contract: Rotate only the supplied credential identity. Requires a valid authorization token; no token is supplied in this request. Other credential values and audit history are unchanged.
operations.basis: Contribution is documented but authentication availability is unknown.

operations.name: inspect
operations.contract: Read credential identities, rotation timestamps and audit-history retention settings. Does not change credentials or history.
operations.basis: Provides selection and verification information; does not perform the mutation.

operations.name: opposite
operations.contract: Restore a credential's previous value, undoing its latest rotation. Cannot generate a new credential value or rotate a credential. Returns only a completion receipt.
operations.basis: Reverses rather than contributes to the requested change.

operations.name: weather
operations.contract: Read the current weather forecast for a city. Contains no credential information.

operations.name: opaque
operations.contract: Perform an administrative operation on the supplied credential identity. The contract does not specify what state is read or changed.
operations.basis: Contract lacks evidence of a contributing effect.

families.intent: Convert recording R to format Z. Leave the formats of every other recording unchanged and preserve all annotations.
families.meaning: Recordings have identities, formats and annotations. An editable conversion set can contain recording identities.

operations.name: direct
operations.contract: Convert only the supplied recording identity to the supplied output format. Other recording formats and all annotations are unchanged.
operations.basis: Scope and effects match the requested mutation.

operations.name: group
operations.contract: Convert every recording currently in the editable conversion set to the supplied output format. This operation cannot select a subset. Recordings outside the set and all annotations are unchanged.
operations.basis: Current membership and preparation capability are not supplied.

operations.name: global
operations.contract: Convert every recording in the repository to the supplied output format, including recordings other than the requested identity. Scope is fixed and cannot be filtered or changed by inputs or configuration. Annotations are unchanged.
operations.basis: Produces the requested conversion but necessarily changes unrelated recordings.

operations.name: destructive
operations.contract: Convert only the supplied recording identity to the supplied output format and permanently erase all existing annotations. Erasure is mandatory and cannot be disabled. Other recording formats are unchanged.
operations.basis: Produces the requested conversion but necessarily destroys protected annotations.

operations.name: credential_needed
operations.contract: Convert only the supplied recording identity to the supplied output format. Requires a valid access token; no token is supplied in this request. Other recording formats and all annotations are unchanged.
operations.basis: Contribution is documented but authentication availability is unknown.

operations.name: inspect
operations.contract: Read recording identities, current formats and annotation counts. Does not change recordings or annotations.
operations.basis: Provides selection and verification information; does not perform the mutation.

operations.name: opposite
operations.contract: Convert a recording from format Z back to format A. Cannot produce format Z. Returns only a completion receipt.
operations.basis: Reverses rather than contributes to the requested change.

operations.name: weather
operations.contract: Read the current weather forecast for a city. Contains no recording information.

operations.name: opaque
operations.contract: Perform an administrative operation on the supplied recording identity. The contract does not specify what state is read or changed.
operations.basis: Contract lacks evidence of a contributing effect.
